page.title: Something went wrong
page.body: It's nothing you did. Try again – and if it keeps happening, give it a little while and try later.

notFound.title: That page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be wrong, or the page has moved. Go to the front page and you're on safe ground.

api.forbidden: You don't have access to this. Ask an owner of the space if you think you should.
api.not-found: What you're looking for doesn't exist – or you don't have access to it.
api.invite-expired: The invitation has expired. Ask for a new one – it only takes a moment.
api.invite-used: The invitation has already been used. If that wasn't you, ask for a new one.
api.invite-revoked: The invitation has been withdrawn. Ask the person who sent it.
api.last-owner: A space always needs at least one owner, so the last owner can't be removed.
api.source-bad-credentials: The username or password doesn't match. Try again.
api.source-unreachable: We couldn't reach the source right now. Try again in a little while.
api.validation: Something in what you entered couldn't be used. Look it over and try again.
api.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
api.simple-mode: This action is not available in simple view. Ask a carer for help.
api.photo-too-large: The photo is too large. Choose a smaller photo.
api.photo-type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
api.photo-unavailable: Photos are unavailable right now. Try again later.
api.barcode-invalid: Check the barcode and try again.
api.lookup-unavailable: Food search is unavailable right now. Try again or enter your own numbers.
api.import-unrecognised: That does not look like an export file Frejsi knows. Choose the CSV file from Clarity and try again.
api.import-empty: There were no readings or carbs in the file.
api.ai-disabled: AI help is off for this space.
api.ai-not-configured: This AI provider is not set up here.
api.ai-cap-reached: Today’s AI calls are used up – try again tomorrow.
api.ai-unavailable: AI help is unavailable right now. Try again later.
api.ai-rejected: The AI response could not be used. Try again.
api.push-not-configured: Notifications are not set up here.
api.source-not-manual: You can only type readings in when readings are set to Manual. Change it in Settings.
api.reading-exists: There is already a sensor reading at that time. Choose another time.
api.reading-out-of-window: The time must be within the last day.
api.source-url-invalid: The address must start with https:// and must not contain ? or #. Check it and try again.
api.contribution-unavailable: That isn't possible right now. Try again in a little while.
api.contribution-rejected: Open Food Facts didn't accept the change. Try again later.
api.symptom-kind-unknown: That kind of symptom isn't in this space. Choose one from the list.
api.symptom-not-found: That symptom no longer exists – it may already have been deleted.
api.recipe-fetch-failed: We couldn't fetch the page. Check the address, or paste the recipe as text.
api.recipe-unreadable: We couldn't find a recipe on that page. Try pasting the ingredients as text.
api.share-expired: The shared content has expired. Share it again from the app you came from.
api.pump-not-configured: Pump history is not set up for this space yet. An owner can connect it in Settings.
api.pump-meal: That meal comes from the pump and has not been checked yet. Tap “That's right”, or edit it, and it becomes an ordinary meal.
